bdsg.muc_dich: Tran tren cua ho mo hinh nay. Chi co nghia khi da co tang nen tieng Viet quy mo GB — huan luyen 295M tham so tren it du lieu chi ton tien de duoc mot mo hinh hoc thuoc.
bdsg.ten_truong_theo_chuan_nao: Ten cac truong o tren la CHUAN TRANSFORMERS — quy uoc chung cua he sinh thai mo hinh mo, khong phai cua rieng du an nao. Khoa 'bdsg' la ghi chu, phai bo truoc khi goi CauHinhBDSG(**cfg).

tham_so.trang_thai: TINH RA, CHUA DEM TREN MO HINH THAT (26/09/2026).

bo_nho.don_vi_ghi_chu: MiB = 1024^2 byte, GiB = 1024^3, KiB = 1024. Kho tinh theo luy thua 2 vi cau hoi thuc te la co vua RAM/VRAM khong, ma RAM va VRAM deu dem theo luy thua 2. mo-hinh/cau_hinh.py in CUNG cac dai luong nay theo MB THAP PHAN (1e6 byte) nen so ben do lon hon 4,86%: hai don vi, khong phai hai ket qua. Khoa trong_so_fp16_MB_thap_phan ben duoi la cung luong byte ay doi sang MB thap phan, vi kich thuoc tep tai ve thi the gioi quen doc theo don vi do.
bo_nho.huan_luyen_tinh_ra_sao: 295.748.608 * 16 byte / 1024^3 = 4,41 GiB trang thai toi uu. CHUA co activation.

phan_cung_that.suy_luan: May ca nhan tu 8 GB RAM o fp32 (1,1 GiB trong so), hoac tu 4 GB o fp16 (564 MiB = 591,5 MB thap phan). TINH RA, chua do.
phan_cung_that.huan_luyen: Mot GPU 24 GB (RTX 3090 / 4090 / A5000): 4,41 GiB trang thai toi uu con lai ~19 GB cho activation. Tren GPU 16 GB thi con phai giam batch va co the phai bat gradient checkpointing — CHUA DO nen khong khang dinh duoc.
phan_cung_that.dieu_kien_tien_quyet: Cau hinh nay CHUA NEN CHAY. Theo ti le kinh nghiem ~20 token du lieu cho moi tham so (Chinchilla, arXiv:2203.15556 — quy tac kinh nghiem chu KHONG phai dinh luat), 295,75 M tham so can khoang 5,9 ty token. Ngu lieu nghiep vu cua BDSG do duoc 26/09/2026 la 7.474.485 ky tu. Voi tokenizer tieng Viet cua BDSG (3,59 ky tu/token, do 25/09/2026) do la khoang 2,08 trieu token — tuc 0,035% cho so can. Ngu lieu tieng Viet mo quy mo GB la dieu kien tien quyet, va no CHUA duoc tai ve.

vi_sao_chon_so_nay: hidden 1024 / 24 lop: buoc nhay deu tiep theo trong ho (512/8 -> 768/16 -> 1024/24). Tang ca be rong lan chieu sau de ti le giua chung khong lech han so voi hai ban duoi.
num_attention_heads=16 voi head_dim=64: 16 * 64 = 1024 = hidden_size. Giu head_dim=64 xuyen suot ca ba ban.
num_key_value_heads=4 tren 16 query head: ti le GQA 4:1. Bo dem KV con 1/4 so voi MHA — 24 KiB thay vi 96 KiB moi token. O quy mo nay bo dem KV bat dau lon that: 48 MiB cho ngu canh 2048.
intermediate_size=2816 = 8/3 * 1024 = 2730,67 lam tron len boi so 128 (22 * 128).
vocab_size, max_position_embeddings, rope_theta, tie_word_embeddings: GIU Y HET hai ban kia. Cung mot ho mo hinh.
canh_bao: Cau hinh nay la mot CHO DANH SAN, khong phai mot loi hua. Truoc khi chay no phai co tang nen tieng Viet quy mo GB. Chay no tren 7 MB ngu lieu nghiep vu thi ket qua khong phai mot mo hinh yeu — ma la mot mo hinh hoc thuoc 11.699 doan ho so va tra loi moi cau hoi bang cach ghep manh ho so lai.
Ap dung nguyen canh bao vocab_size o nho.json.
So tham so la SO TINH RA, doi chieu voi phep dem that khi da co mo-hinh/.
